director_notes: Bolumun gorsel fikri: 'kagit uzerindeki ay ussu'. Acilista bos, kraterli Ay yuzeyi ve duraklatilan Gateway ile gerilim kuruyoruz; asil konu (ay yuzeyi, LCROSS, iniscilar, PROMISE, MoonFall, reaktor) NASA arsiv goruntuleri ve gercek gorev gorselleriyle anlatiliyor, genel cümleler ise renkli, surekli hareket eden kozmik aralara (nebulalar, galaksiler, Saturn, Jupiter, Gunes) baglaniyor; boylece sahnelerin yaklasik uctebiri kozmik cutaway. Her sahnede yavas itme, geri cekilme, pan veya paralaks var; art arda iki sahne ayni gorsel stilde olmuyor (arsiv fotografi, termal harita, makro toz, nebula, render, stilize poster dönüşümlü). Kanıt sahneleri (EVIDENCE) kanit sayacini tetikler. Palet: lacivert, mor, kehribar, buz beyazi. Kapanista Gateway sorusuna donup 'kraterlerin icine' merak dongusuyle bitiyoruz.

thumbnail.layout: Tek odak: Ay'in guney kutbunda golgede kalmis krater kenari; ustte yari silik, mor cizgili hayalet istasyon silueti ve yaninda kucuk bir duraklat simgesi. Sol yarida gercek foto dokusu, sag yarida blueprint cizgisi ('kagit uzerinde' mesaji). Basliklar sol ustte, Montserrat ExtraBold, buz beyazi, iki satir (GATEWAY PAUSED. / WHY?); 'PAUSED' kelimesi amber. Arka plan derin uzay lacivert, ufukta amber gunes isigi. Metin guvenli kenar bosluklarinin icinde, telefonda okunur.

design_notes: Toplam 32 overlay: 24 ana overlay (hepsi 6 kelime veya altinda, buyuk Montserrat ExtraBold, en az 64 px, %10 guvenli kenarlarin icinde, gerektiginde yumusak koyu scrim) ve gercek bir gorevi gosteren yapay zeka sahneleri (19, 20, 29, 33, 35, 38, 52, 54) icin 8 kucuk 'Illustration' etiketi (sag ust kose, yaklasik 30 px, in 0.3 s, sahne suresi eksi 0.3 s). Faz overlay'leri artik 'PHASE 1: NOW–2029', 'PHASE 2: 2029–2032', 'PHASE 3: 2032+'. Kanit sayaci artik yalnizca gercek kanit ogelerinin oldugu 8 sahnede (6, 17, 19, 31, 35, 38, 45, 52) 1'den 8'e sayarak goruluyor: ust kosede sayi ve kisa etiket, sonra kayboluyor. Maliyet, uc faz, Artemis tarihleri, ogrenci yarismasi ve Moon Base One sayaclari kaldirildi. Sayac ve Illustration etiketi ust koseyi paylasabilir; sayac sol ust, etiket sag ust tutulmali. Palet: lacivert #0B1026, mor #6C3BFF, kehribar #FFB020, buz beyazi #F2F5FF; kucuk etiketlerde Inter. Kucuk resimde en fazla dort kelime: GATEWAY PAUSED. WHY? | Render öncesi: gerçek NASA görseli kullanılan sahnelerden (33, 38) 'Illustration' etiketi kaldırıldı; kodla çizilen veya sanatçı çizimi sahnelerde (14, 19, 20, 21, 29, 35, 37, 46, 52, 53, 54) etiket var.
style_guide:
# Rebel Minds: Cosmos — Style Guide

## Voice
Curious, slightly rebellious, evidence-driven. We question the consensus but never overclaim. We make the viewer feel smart, not lectured. No hype words ("scientists are shocked", "this changes everything", "proves").

## Script
- Language: English. Pace: ~140 words per minute. Default length: 10 minutes.
- First 15 seconds: a hook built on genuine tension or a question — no false promises.
- Short-to-medium sentences written for text-to-speech; no parentheses; numbers written the way they should be spoken.
- Cite every factual sentence with [S1], [S2]… mapped to a `## Sources` list.
- Put `[EVIDENCE: short label]` on its own line right before a NEW piece of evidence is introduced (drives the evidence tracker).
- Open curiosity loops and pay them off. Reflective close, one natural call to action.

## Visuals
- Colourful, constantly moving cosmic imagery. Even general statements get cosmic cutaways (star clusters, planets, discs, nebulae) — never a static or empty frame.
- Never the same visual style twice in a row; never the same image twice in an episode.
- Prefer real imagery (NASA/ESA/ESO) when the narration refers to a real mission, object or instrument.
- Every scene has motion: slow push-in, pull-out, pan, parallax, rotation.

## On-screen text (must be legible on a phone)
- Max 6 words per overlay, large bold sans-serif (min 64 px height on a 1080p frame), inside 10% safe margins, high contrast (soft dark scrim when needed).
- Few overlays rather than many — only where they help understanding or land a key number.

## Evidence tracker
A recurring graphic that appears ONLY when a new piece of evidence is introduced (count + short label), then disappears. Never permanent clutter.

## Palette & type
- Deep space navy `#0B1026`, cosmic violet `#6C3BFF`, solar amber `#FFB020`, ice white `#F2F5FF`
- Montserrat ExtraBold (headings/overlays), Inter (small labels)

## Thumbnail
Max 4 words, one focal subject, readable at phone size, palette colours.

scenes.narration: NASA says it is building a base on the Moon. None of the Moon Base missions has landed yet.
scenes.motion: slow push-in with slight parallax on the horizon

image.title: A Breathtaking Earthset from Orion
image.reason: Artemis II'nin Ay'in uzak yuzu yakinindan cektigi gercek fotograf, gri kraterli Ay kenarini ve siyah uzayi gosteriyor; 'bos ova' yerine Ay limbi var ama hook icin guclu ve durust bir uyum.

scenes.narration: The first three have slipped to 2027. And to chase this base, the agency put its own planned space station around the Moon on hold.
scenes.motion: slow pull-out with gentle rotation of the station
scenes.ai_prompt: Cinematic 16:9 render of a small modular space station in orbit around the Moon, Earth in the distance, lights dimming, cool navy and amber palette, no text

scenes.narration: So why did NASA pause Gateway? And what is real here, and what is still on paper?
scenes.motion: slow parallax drift through the gas layers

image.reason: Webb'in Carina Nebulasi 'Cosmic Cliffs' goruntusu renkli ve gizemli nebula sutunlariyla brief'e tam uyuyor.

scenes.narration: In March 2026, NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman paused Gateway, a planned outpost in lunar orbit.
scenes.motion: slow lateral pan along the modules

image.reason: HALO modulunun insan olmadan cekilmis metalik kapak yakin plani, Gateway donanimini gosteriyor; orbit kavramini dogrudan vermiyor.

scenes.narration: The pause is indefinite. The stated goal was to focus on a base on the surface.

image.title: South Pole Region of the Moon as Seen by Clementine
image.reason: Clementine'in Ay guney kutbu mozaigi, yorungeden guney kutup bolgesine inis brief'iyle dogrudan uyumlu.

scenes.narration: Notice the word paused. NASA says Gateway is not cancelled, and its hardware may be repurposed.

image.title: Thruster Gimbal Range of Motion Testing for Gateway’s Power and Propulsion Element jsc2026e005282
image.reason: PPE itme sistemi gimbal testi, PPE donanimiyla ilgili; ancak temiz oda hissi ve hazir ama kullanilmamis donanim gorunumu tam olarak yok.

scenes.narration: But much of that hardware was already built, and it is not easy to reuse.

image.title: Gateway's HALO Arrives in Arizona for Final Outfitting (jsc2025e036496)
image.reason: HALO modulunun uretim hallerinde tasinmasi ve dolly uzerindeki gorunumu, fabrika ortaminda insa edilmis modul brief'ine uygun.

scenes.narration: The effort moves from orbit down to the ground, near the polar ice.

image.title: Seeing Stars in Serpens
image.reason: Spitzer'in Serpens bolgesi goruntusu kirmizi-pembe parlayan yildiz olusum bulutlariyla brief'teki renkli nebula hissine yakin.

scenes.narration: The fate of partners like Europe, Japan and Canada is still unresolved.

image.title: Gateway Close-up - ESPRIT Refueling Module
image.credit: NASA/JSC — Gateway Summer Req Images Rev2_15
image.reason: ESA'nin ESPRIT yakit ikmal modulu, Avrupa katkisi donanimi brief'iyle uyumlu ve sinematik bir yakin plan sunuyor.

scenes.narration: The price tag is about twenty billion dollars over the first seven years, and about thirty billion over a decade for all three phases.

image.title: NASA's Artemis II SLS Rocket and Orion Spacecraft Rollout to Launch Pad 39B
image.reason: Artemis II SLS roketinin alcak aci ile rampaya cikisi, mavi gokyuzu ve yol perspektifiyle olcek ve gucu verebiliyor.

scenes.narration: Now, the word base. Picture a city under a dome. That is not what NASA describes, at least not yet.

image.title: CADRE Rover on the Moon (Artist's Concept)
image.reason: CADRE rover'in Ay yuzeyinde cekilmis konsepti, cıplak regolit uzerinde kalmak icin uygun; kubbeli sehir yok.

image.reason: Hot Fire robotik inis aracinin test fotografi robotik iniş aracini gosteriyor ancak Ay ovasi yerine kapali bir hangar ortaminda.

scenes.narration: Phase Two, 2029 to 2032, adds early power, cargo and communications.

image.title: Lunar Terrain Vehicle Testing
image.reason: Lunar Outpost Eagle arazi aracının kargo tepsisi ve güneş paneli açık, sahne anlatımıyla uyumlu bir test görüntüsü.

scenes.narration: Only Phase Three, from 2032, is the permanent outpost with habitats.

scenes.narration: So today, the Moon Base is a schedule of robotic missions. Not a building.

scenes.narration: But why the south pole? Of all the places on the Moon? The first reason is water.

scenes.motion: slow pan across the map with parallax
scenes.ai_prompt: Scientific false-colour thermal map of lunar south pole craters, deep blue and violet cold pockets, glowing edges, 16:9, no text

scenes.narration: It held about one hundred fifty five kilograms of water. That is only what the plume let us see. It is not a total.
scenes.motion: slow tilt up following the plume

image.title: ARC-2006-ACD06-0232-004
image.reason: LCROSS misyon sanat eseri; Cabeus kenarindan yukselen plume bulutunu ve Shepherding uzay aracini gosteriyor, anlatimdaki plume ve enstrumanlar ile iyi uyumlu. Gercek fotograf degil, NASA Ames'in resmi illustrasyonu.

scenes.narration: What is thin is how much there is, what form it takes, and whether anyone can mine it.

scenes.narration: And this is ice mixed into soil, not lakes. And here is the loop I cannot close. Where did it come from?

scenes.narration: The polar ridges are an exception, with near continuous sun.
